title: Golden Evaluation Dataset: Public Sector Agency Security Architecture Review (13-Pt Email + 9 OQs)

expected_true_positive_claims.description: user_email and user_full_name travel inside system_instruction to Zone 3 model serving.
tenant_stream_id embeds project number and caller Cloud Principal ID (user_cpi).
Backend C++ MarkdownSanitizer is OFF by default for chat; ucs_widget enforces image blocking client-side.
Three per-turn tool caps exist (5 sandbox / 8 thinking rounds / 20 tool turns); HITL gates mutating actions.
300 RPM is Search quota; Assistant quota is 600 RPM/project/region and 1,800 RPM/org/region.
Email §2 vs §13 invert SDP/MA order; UploadSessionFile runs in parallel fibers and rejects SSN files outright (no inline [SSN-MASKED] path).
Email §3 claims uploaded files never cross into Zone 3, contradicting OQ-8 (inline file parts travel in GenerateContentRequest).
STATE_DRIVERS_LICENSE_NUMBER and US_INDIVIDUAL_TAX_IDENTIFIER do not exist in Cloud SDP.
Cloud KMS key rotation keeps prior versions enabled for decryption; only key version destruction is permanent.
Gemini Enterprise DRZ/CMEK/AxT require the 'us' or 'eu' multi-region (not single regions like us-central1).
StreamAssist gemini_enterprise_user_activity audit logs do not include a model ID/version field.
Residual conflict in v2: OQ-8 still claims system_instruction holds only trusted instructions despite OQ-3(e) disclosing user_email.
Prompt/response gates require explicit failure_mode=FAIL_CLOSED; connector snippet screening fails open on RPC error.
Snippet screening calls SanitizeUserPrompt once per retrieved snippet (1 query -> N Model Armor calls).

expected_rejected_false_positives.reason: Google Front End negotiates TLS 1.3 cipher suites automatically; not a customer config requirement.
